description: This file implements the kernel's fatal error handling for ARM64 Cortex-A architecture in Zephyr RTOS, including functions for handling fatal errors, kernel oops, and system halt, with debug and stack protection features.

methods.name: z_arm64_safe_exception_stack_init
methods.description: Initializes a safe exception stack for the current CPU.

methods.name: dump_esr
methods.description: Dumps the ESR register contents with detailed error info.

methods.name: esf_dump
methods.description: Dumps the exception stack frame registers.

methods.name: esf_unwind
methods.description: Unwinds the call stack for debugging purposes.

methods.name: z_arm64_stack_corruption_check
methods.description: Checks for stack corruption or overflow during exceptions.

methods.name: is_recoverable
methods.description: Determines if an exception is recoverable based on its context.

methods.name: z_arm64_fatal_error
methods.description: Handles a fatal error, performing diagnostics and then halting.

methods.name: z_arm64_do_kernel_oops
methods.description: Handles a kernel oops event triggered by software.

methods.name: arch_syscall_oops
methods.description: Handles a system call oops, used in user space.

methods.name: arch_system_halt
methods.description: Halts the system, typically for poweroff or panic.
